text:
sam: Heads-up — seeing a weird allocation ripple in us-west1 GPU pools. ~40 pods pending in tiny-gpu pools; scheduler shows lots of nodes being skipped. anyone else?
tara: yep noticed a spike ~10:02. small pods keep getting evicted/backfilled, can't stabilize.😕
oliver: grabbing scheduler logs now. quick snippet: 
```
kube-scheduler: binding failed: NodeAffinityMismatch: node 'gke-usw1-ephem-42' does not satisfy required label gpu.ephemeral=ok (found gpu.ephemeral=stale)
```
this looks like a label race between node-labeler and node registration.
infra-bot: Alert: autoscaler scaled down pool "ephemeral-small" (2 nodes) at 10:00 UTC. Related pods marked Pending (PodFitsHostPorts false, NodeAffinityMismatch).
tara: my hypothesis: ephemeral nodes are getting a transient label value during scale-in (labeler writes before kubelet finishes), scheduler sees inconsistent label and refuses to bind, then pods get rescheduled -> fragmentation + evictions.
leila: FYI this caused cross-region drift — some workloads spilled to us-east and got preempted; rough cost impact ~ $2k last 3 hours (egress + spot retries).
sam: temporary mitigations: 1) re-label affected nodes to gpu.ephemeral=ok 2) run a short rescheduler to nudge Pending pods 3) put a 15s delay in the labeler after cloud node create to avoid overwrite race.
oliver: can run commands to force-label now: 
```
kubectl get nodes -l pool=ephemeral -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl label --overwrite {} gpu.ephemeral=ok
```
(we'll need to run carefully; maybe use -l pool=ephemeral,region=us-west1)
tara: also add a fallback in scheduler predicate: ignore ephemeral label for pods requesting <1 GPU for next 24h while we patch node-labeler. low-risk.
sam: creating INFRA ticket and a short runbook. JIRA: INFRA-2345. I'll run the label command and start rescheduler in 5m.
infra-bot: Incident created: INFRA-2345 (auto-created from channel alert). Priority: P2.
leila: thanks — i'll update cost slack and poke billing to hold on alerts while we stabilize.
tara: quick after-action: we should add a prober that verifies final label state before marking node Ready in kubelet-register flow. saves a lot of noisy evictions.
sam: agreed. will PR fixes: labeler delay + prober + sched fallback. monitoring: watch pending/gpu-small ratio and eviction spikes for 2h. :thumbsup:
